en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Before I left the academy...
I decided to talk alone with Kokichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the last day we'll spend
at this academy...

<CLT=cltMIND>This school life was crazy, but now that
I think back on it, we had some good times.

Maaan...it shocks me how booooring our
school life was.

I thought there would be at least one or
two murders...

Nee-heehee... But I'm so glad nothing
violent happened.
...Is that a lie?
Who can say?

I've been lying so much lately that I can't
even tell what's true or not anymore.

Oh, yeah...
Do you still remember our promise, Shuichi?
Promise?

Y-You forgot... How could you...?
But we swore to each other...

Y-You're lying, right!?
You remember it, don't you!?
<CLT=cltMIND>The promise I made to Kokichi...
To join his evil organization?
To let him kill me?
I didn't make any promises...
To join your evil organization?

Yeah, that! You have to work under me for free
as a member of my secret organization—

No, wait!
I never promised anything like that!
Oh. Do you remember then?

<CLT=cltMIND>Phew, that was close.
The real promise was...
To let you kill me?
So, you actually remember.

Yeah, you promised you would lose in a game.
And after that, I would get to kill you.

Wait...didn't I win that game?
You forfeited.

Booooring.
You totally remember.

<CLT=cltMIND>Phew, that was close.
The real promise was...
Wait a minute, I didn't make any promises...
Welp, I guess you remember.
A liar to the end, huh Kokichi?

If I don't have lies, then I don't have anything
else! My body is made up of 70% lies!

That's...not exactly something
to be proud of.
But hey, my lies never bored you, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't want to admit it...
But that is true.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because Kokichi kept lying and never
clued me in on his real intentions...

<CLT=cltMIND>I felt like I was being drawn in,
always wanting to know more.

I suppose I was in the palm of your
hand until the very end...

Hearing those words from you
tooootally made lying worth it!
Since I lie to entertain people!
That's a lie too, isn't it?
Who knows?

Well anyway, let's keep this relationship going
even after we get out of here.
Even after we get out of here?

Because you don't actually know anything
about me, do you?
You wanna get to know the real me, right?
Then you should stay by my side.
<CLT=cltMIND>...Kokichi is right.

<CLT=cltMIND>I want...
I want to know more about him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Where do the lies end
and the truth begins?

<CLT=cltMIND>What about him is true?
What about him is not true?

<CLT=cltMIND>To find all that out...I shook
the hand extended to me.

<CLT=cltMIND>He can lie about a lot of things...
But he can't hide the warmth of his hand.

<CLT=cltMIND>And thus, our days at the
Ultimate Academy for Gifted Juveniles...
<CLT=cltMIND>came to an end.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme,
"Love Across the Universe."
